create_LaikagoMotorModel: create a LaikagoMotorModel instance with custom kp kd gains and torque limits for PD motor control
set_strength_ratios: set the relative strength ratios of all 12 motors using a numpy array from 0.0 to 1.0
set_motor_gains: set the proportional and derivative PD gains for all motors in the LaikagoMotorModel
convert_to_torque_POSITION: convert motor position commands to torque using PD control with the LaikagoMotorModel convert_to_torque method
convert_to_torque_HYBRID: convert hybrid motor commands with position velocity and torque fields to torque using convert_to_torque
